```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(plotly)
library(datasets)
```

## Overview & Dataset

- **Course Project:** Developing Data Products (Week 3 Assignment).
- **Objective:** Build an interactive presentation using R Markdown and Plotly.
- **Dataset:** `mtcars` (Motor Trend Car Road Tests).
- **Interactive features:**
  - Hover tooltip metrics.
  - Multi-variable mapping (Weight, MPG, Horsepower, Cylinders).
  - Zoom and pan capabilities.

## Interactive Vehicle Analysis

```{r plotly_chart}
data(mtcars)
mtcars$cyl <- as.factor(mtcars$cyl)

plot_ly(
  data = mtcars,
  x = ~wt,
  y = ~mpg,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  color = ~cyl,
  size = ~hp,
  sizes = c(8, 24),
  text = ~paste(
    "Car:", rownames(mtcars),
    "<br>MPG:", mpg,
    "<br>Weight (1000 lbs):", wt,
    "<br>HP:", hp,
    "<br>Cylinders:", cyl
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Fuel Efficiency (MPG) vs Weight by Cylinders",
    xaxis = list(title = "Weight (1,000 lbs)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Miles Per Gallon (MPG)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "<b>Cylinders</b>"))
  )
```
